title: How to read Tab 1 · All Stocks
description: Read current behaviour first. Use 5D reach as historical context, not as a claim that a trade captured five percent.

columns.whatItShows: Non-overlapping close-to-close movement buckets: the latest 5 sessions, the 5 sessions before that, and the 10 sessions before those.
columns.whyImportant: Shows whether the current move is continuing upward, recovering from a decline, weakening, or steady without requiring mental subtraction from overlapping windows.
columns.howToRead: Green means that bucket moved up; red means it moved down. Accelerating requires a positive Now 5D move that improves by at least 1 percentage point versus Prior 5D. Recovering means both periods are negative but the latest decline is smaller. Weakening means the latest pace is worse by at least 1 percentage point.
columns.caution: The amber warning appears in Latest close when the 20D move is above +25%; it is not an automatic rejection. Check Strong finishes, Move quality, Latest finish, and Volume activity.

columns.whatItShows: How many of the latest five sessions closed above 60% of that day's low-to-high range, with a dot for each day.
columns.whyImportant: Repeated high-range closes suggest buyers controlled the close across several sessions.
columns.howToRead: 4 / 5 with four filled dots means four strong finishes. Dots are ordered newest first.
columns.caution: A strong close is evidence of demand, not proof that the next move must continue. Read it beside Latest finish for the most recent candle.

columns.whatItShows: Whether the latest five-session move is Clean, Mixed, or Wild.
columns.whyImportant: Separates a controlled upward move from a choppy or inefficient move.
columns.howToRead: Clean means steady upward movement; Mixed means usable but imperfect; Wild means sharp reversals or inefficient movement.
columns.caution: This is descriptive context and does not filter or rank stocks.

columns.whatItShows: Whether any of the latest three sessions had abnormal volume compared with its preceding 10-session average.
columns.whyImportant: Calls out unusual participation without pretending to know whether it came from buyers or sellers.
columns.howToRead: Quiet means no recent session reached 1.5x the preceding 10-session average. Watch means at least one recent session reached 1.5x or more; the displayed multiple and date identify the event.
columns.caution: Volume alone does not identify entry or exit. Interpret Watch alongside Move now, Strong finishes, Latest finish, and the daily details popup.

columns.whatItShows: The latest completed closing price and date, the total 20D close-to-close move, and the latest close's distance from the recent 20-session high.
columns.whyImportant: Anchors every other signal to the current price observation.
columns.howToRead: Read `20D +7.1% · -3.2% from high` as a positive 20D move with the latest close 3.2% below the recent high. The amber ⚠ means the 20D move is above +25% and needs extension caution.
columns.caution: The warning is context, not a rejection. A strong move can still be valid, but do not chase it without a good entry location.

columns.whatItShows: How often the price touched at least +5% within the next five sessions from each tested starting close.
columns.whyImportant: Shows whether the stock has historically offered short-horizon upside range.
columns.howToRead: 12 / 20 means 12 tested starting points later reached +5% within five sessions.
columns.caution: It does not mean twelve profitable trades, twelve captured targets, or that the stock is moving 5% every five days.

columns.whatItShows: Where the latest close finished between that day's low and high, with candle direction.
columns.whyImportant: Shows the strength or weakness of the most recent completed candle.
columns.howToRead: HIGH means the close was at least 75% of the range; MID is between; LOW means it was at most 25%.
columns.caution: One candle should be read with the five-session Strong finishes sequence.

columns.whatItShows: The day's volume as a multiple of the preceding ten completed sessions' average volume.
columns.whyImportant: Uses a responsive short-horizon baseline that matches the Volume activity signal.
columns.howToRead: 1.5x means 50% above the average volume of the preceding ten sessions; 0.5x means half.
columns.caution: Volume alone does not identify accumulation or distribution; combine it with price and close position.

bestCombination: A useful current-condition combination is a positive Now 5D and Prior 5D, repeated Strong finishes, Clean move quality, and Volume activity read as neutral context.
importantNote: Tab 1 is an observation screen. It does not create a buy signal, and Tab 2 filtering rules are separate.
